replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not typically. I’ve used math since my early years for practical tasks, so it feels grounded and logical. Anxiety comes from abstract concepts I haven’t encountered yet, but I tackle those step by step without stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used a simple calculator app for quick checks but never complex AI. I prefer hands-on practice over digital tools. It’s efficient for basic calculations, but I’d rather work through problems myself to build confidence.

If it’s positive, you get two real roots; if zero, one real root; if negative, complex roots. Finally, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a).

Take the first derivative f’(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. These x-values are where the slope is zero, indicating potential maxima or minima. Plug them back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values for the stationary points.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture the most variance.
